source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 285 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 285.

PD 285.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 285 was established by Ordinance No. 19792, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 16, 1987. Ordinance No. 19792 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 285 is established on property generally located along the west line of Hillcrest Road, south of the south line of Alpha Road. The size of PD 285 is approximately 6.6392 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 285A). (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit for work on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.106. LANDSCAPING.

A landscape plan that complies with applicable provisions of the Dallas Development Code must be submitted to the city plan commission concurrently with the development plan, and must be approved prior to the issuance of any building permit for work on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.107. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are an electrical substation use and a public or private recreational area use. For the purposes of this article, a public or private recreational area means an area providing recreational facilities such as playgrounds, parks, and playing fields, but not game courts, swimming pools, or golf courses. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.108. HEIGHT.

Maximum height for an electrical substation use is 30 feet, except as otherwise provided for utility uses in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.109. BUILDING SETBACKS.

A minimum 80-foot front yard setback must be provided along the frontage of the Property on Hillcrest Road. A minimum 10-foot side and rear yard setback must be provided on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Electrical Substation Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.110. ELECTRICAL SUBSTATION SIZE.

The area occupied by the electrical substation use may not exceed 120 feet by 320 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.111. SCREENING.

The electrical substation use must be completely enclosed by a green-colored chain link fence that is no less than eight feet in height. In addition, a solid screen of evergreen plant materials that is no less than eight feet in height must be provided. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Private Driveway
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.112. PRIVATE DRIVEWAY.

A private driveway that does not exceed 20 feet in width must connect the electrical substation use to Hillcrest Road. There may be no more than one point of access to the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.113. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking must be provided in accordance with the applicable requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Median Openings
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.114. MEDIAN OPENINGS.

No additional median openings are permitted on Hillcrest Road. Existing median openings are shown on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Flood Plain
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.115. FLOOD PLAIN.

(a) Filling of the flood plain must comply with applicable provisions of the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All flood plain is restricted to public or private recreational area use. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Platting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.116. PLATTING.

At the time of submission of the development plan, a preliminary plat for the Property must also be submitted. A final plat must be approved by the city plan commission and recorded with the county clerk prior to issuance of a building permit for work on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.117. MAINTENANCE.

The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.118. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.119. PAVING.

(a) The paving of parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must comply with the standards set forth in the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.120. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-285.121. ZONING MAP.

PD 285 is located on Zoning Map Nos. C-7 and D-7. (Ord. Nos. 19792; 25711)
